lines.text: Welcome! Another busy day for you, I see.
Care for some strawberry candy?
Why don't you rest for a while? No use in running when you can barely walk!
I wonder if my little brother will be as outstanding as you.
You can only buy this Splendamin at the train station! It's delicious, want some more?
Being held by you feels... nice.
Hey, don't hide! I've got candies for you!

Commander, let's sing a song!
Ride the AZX rails, destination: Happiness!
When you come to the train station, strawberry candies are on me!
There's the AZX! Schwooooosh! There it goes!
Commander, are you bored?
How about some candy for the road?
Heehee, thanks for your help!
I'll try and get stronger so I can protect you.
I really appreciate all that you do for me.
Is this for me? You're kidding!
Thank you, Commander!
I'm so happy!
Every day with you is a happy one, Commander.
I'm so lucky to have you around.
I want to get on the AZX with you, and travel the whole world!
Oh boy, oh boy, it's my turn!
Heehee, are you calling me?
Yes, on my way!
Wowzers! Take care of yourselves everyone!
Just calm down and give it another shot.
Be careful, everyone.
Time to get serious.
Reload?
Calm down...
Dust yourself off and give it another go!
I'm ready!
May victory be ours!
Charge!
Phew... That's settled.
Let's put our backs into it.
Let's get a few more hits in!
Argh.
Ow.
Argh!
Aw shucks, they got the best of my strawberry candies...
Wowee, we won! Oh happy day, Commander!
